description: This file implements the Cbor class for encoding data into CBOR format, including UTF-8 validation and message creation, within the confui namespace of the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: Cbor
classes.description: Class responsible for creating CBOR encoded messages, including UTF-8 validation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the CBOR map with prompt and extra data, encodes it into a buffer, and handles errors.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Returns the encoded CBOR message buffer.

methods.name: CheckUTF8Copy
methods.description: Validates that a string is valid UTF-8, checking multi-byte sequences.
